reason: Rifiutare or respingere is familiar general vocabulary, while the more marked manners of rejection are taught by the retained rebuff and repudiate cards.
Rivedere is a familiar broad verb, and the context-free prompt does not select textual revision, policy reconsideration or exam review.
Vagliare and passare al vaglio teach a precise institutional examination sense and avoid overusing the rare cognate scrutinare.
Sottolineare is a familiar figurative equivalent at C1, and this bare prompt adds no distinct construction beyond ordinary emphasis.
Affermare is a transparent, high-frequency analytical verb, and no legal, performative or emphatic sense is selected by the isolated prompt.
Italian attribution verbs do not alone encode lack of proof, so the card teaches how context and evidential framing carry the allegation sense.
With evidence and theses, rafforzare, consolidare and avvalorare offer a useful collocational and register distinction.
Sollevare una questione captures introducing a topic and corrects legacy affrontare, which can imply actually dealing with it.
Aggirare versus eludere teaches intentional regulatory avoidance and avoids confusion with the unrelated Italian circonvenire.
The rare, affected English verb adds no productive Italian sense beyond the stronger retained ruminate card and ordinary riflettere or meditare.
Avvalorare distinguishes evidential support from definitive proof, while the valid cognate corroborare carries a notably higher register.
The argumentative sense teaches ribattere a and contrasts it with contrastare for opposing threats or tendencies.
Dedurre is a transparent academic equivalent, and the inferential construction is already represented by a more contrastive infer card in the preceding batch.
Obiettare and esprimere riserve preserve a restrained objection and prevent the stronger mistranslation respingere.
Denigrare is a transparent advanced cognate with the same ordinary object pattern, and the bare prompt supplies no distinct reputational construction.
Deridere is a direct, familiar cognate at this level, and no contrast between ridicule, mockery and contempt is selected by the prompt.
The card teaches the more current analytical individuare and marks discernere as elevated despite reinforcement from Spanish and French cognates.
Diffondere and divulgare carry a useful distinction between broad distribution and accessible communication of specialist knowledge.
The Italian verb changes with the object: reactions are suscitate, whereas information is ottenuta or fatta emergere.
A figuratively embellished account teaches a potentially deceptive sense beyond literal beautification and contrasts abbellire with marked infiorare.
Abbracciare, sposare and fare propria express adherence to a view and prevent confusion with the unrelated Italian esporre.
The deceptive sense motivates inventare di sana pianta or costruire ad arte rather than automatically selecting material fabbricare.
Comprendere appieno preserves complete understanding and avoids importing the English verb's literal nautical metaphor.
Ricavare da and desumere da teach government and the nuance of obtaining limited information from indirect or scattered evidence.
Insistere continuamente su supplies the required preposition and calibrates the criticism more carefully than legacy ossessivamente.
Challenging credibility calls for mettere in dubbio or contestare, whereas Italian impugnare strongly suggests a legal appeal or a grasped object.
Inculcare is an exact, established formal cognate, and this context-free prompt offers no selected value, audience or construction beyond that direct mapping.
Incriminare requires a jurisdictional warning because indictment is not conviction and does not map neatly onto every Italian procedural stage.
Insinuare is a transparent and familiar cognate in argumentative prose, and the source does not select suggestion, infiltration or gradual insertion.
Elogiare is the current rendering, while the tempting cognate laudare is rare and stylistically unsuitable for ordinary media commentary.
Riflettere a lungo or ponderare adds no distinct lesson beside the earlier retained ponder card; the more negatively repetitive ruminate remains distinct here.
Natural Italian normally uses ritenere or esprimere un parere, while the cognate opinare is rare and often sounds affected.
Postulare is a transparent academic cognate, and the hypothesis-setting sense is already taught more contrastively by the retained posit card in the preceding batch.
The legal term has real teaching value because promulgare, emanare, approvare and pubblicare identify different institutional acts.
Respingere con fermezza captures a firm rejection without automatically importing the unsupported discourtesy of legacy bruscamente.
Ricapitolare is a transparent and familiar discourse verb whose ordinary transitive use offers no new construction at C1.
Confutare teaches the evidential requirement that distinguishes refutation from merely denying or contesting a claim.
Ribadire is more idiomatic for restating a position, while the cognate reiterare often sounds bureaucratic and favors requests or repeated acts.
Rinnegare and ripudiare distinguish prior commitment from solemn rejection and supply a useful cross-language spelling trap.
Rimuginare su conveys repetitive, often brooding thought and contrasts with the rarer literary cognate ruminare and neutral reflection.
